title: IE11 doesn't work  anymore
body:
Hi,

It seems that InstantSearch doesn't work anymore with IE 11.
I try to use polyfill (like on the doc) but it doesn't work...

It work well before i change the rooting config. Previously i was using urlsync. 

I have a console error `":" expected` on the line of the stateToRoute function.

Polyfill never works when i was using urlsync. So i had to block the website for IE < 11.

Now it seems that i have to block it for all IE, that i don't want.

Thanks for your help.

I use :
https://ajax.googleapis.com/ajax/libs/jquery/3.2.1/jquery.min.js
https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/algoliasearch/3/algoliasearch.min.js
https://cdn.polyfill.io/v2/polyfill.min.js?features=default,Array.prototype.includes

comments.body: I didn't manage to reproduce the issue on IE11. Could you please provide us an example that throws an error. It will help us to better understand where the issue come from. Thanks!

I've just had similar issues but managed to get the search functions working fine in IE11. In my case, the fixes were template literals and string concatenation (replace ` with ' and also form strings as 'something' +).

Yes, keep in mind that the code examples of what we write ourselves in the documentation doesn't necessarily work in older browsers. Feel free to check out [babel](https://babeljs.io) to transform your own code to work in older browsers. The library itself will work in IE11 (or whatever is mentioned in the readme)
